proves.claim: replay --all --against prints one line per table with its class counts and a drifted or clean verdict.

cli.replay.all-prints-lines-and-verdict.why: One verdict over every table tells a release script whether the tree still decides recorded moves as the last release did; the command must stay read-only and off by default.
